english.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a petrol station.
Use this for a petrol filling station, not a building for storing a private car.
Use this specifically for a gas or service station.

examples.english: We’ll fill up at the petrol station before getting on the motorway.
examples.traditional: 我哋去油站入滿油先再上高速公路。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 heoi3 jau4 zaam6 jap6 mun5 jau4 sin1 zoi3 soeng6 gou1 cuk1 gung1 lou6

examples.english: I went to the garage to fill up the tank before going home.
examples.traditional: 我去油站入滿缸油先返屋企。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 heoi3 jau4 zaam6 jap6 mun5 gong1 jau4 sin1 faan1 uk1 kei2

examples.english: My car is out of gas, so I need to go to a gas station.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 gaa3 ce1 mou5 jau4 jiu3 jap6 jau4 zaam6
